function.name: plant_biomass

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to live air‑quality feeds, so I can’t give you the exact AQI for Los Angeles at this moment. However, you can check up‑to‑date values from reliable sources such as:

| Source | How to access |
|--------|---------------|
| **AirNow** (U.S. EPA) | https://www.airnow.gov/ |
| **AQICN** (World Air Quality Index) | https://aqicn.org/city/los-angeles/ |
| **Local news sites** (e.g., LA Times, KABC) | Search “Los Angeles AQI” |

These sites provide the current AQI, pollutant breakdowns (PM₂.₅, O₃, NO₂, etc.), and health advisories. If you’d like, I can explain how to interpret those numbers or suggest ways to reduce exposure if the AQI is high.
